Watch A Demo

THREAT EXPOSURE MANAGEMENT 

Scale and Automate Your Exposure Management 

Consolidate and operationalize data from asset discovery, security scanners, exploit and threat intelligence sources with Nucleus, the central hub for your exposure management program. 

Watch On-Demand Demo

Exposure Management Hub 

Centralize your exposure management with Nucleus, to unify your asset, vulnerability, exploit, and threat intelligence data. Automate workflows and gain visibility across assets, clouds, applications, OT, and supply chains — in one platform. 

Centralize Your Program in One Hub 

Unify visibility and manage exposures across all attack surfaces. 

Prioritize and Validate Exploitable Risks 

Prioritize risks with business context, exploit, and threat intelligence. 

Mobilize with Ownership Automation 

Automate asset ownership to accelerate remediation workflows. 

CONTINUOUS DISCOVERY 

Unify Your Exposure Visibility 

Continuously integrate and normalize security data from your security tools, threat intelligence feeds, and manual pen-testing into a unified vulnerability and exposure management platform. With 200+ existing integrations, Nucleus streamlines data ingestion from your existing security stack and simplifies expansion to new scopes. 

PRIORITIZATION 

Prioritize Exposures with Business and Custom Risk Context 

Standardize and tailor prioritization with unified risk scores customized to your organization. With Nucleus, teams can operationalize business and custom risk factors, such as asset criticality, data sensitivity, internet exposure, and compliance scope, to drive precise, context-aware risk prioritization. 

VALIDATED EXPLOITS 

Focus on Exploitable Exposures  

Eliminate noise and zero in on true threats with Nucleus Insights. Combine AI-powered exploitability intelligence, analyst validation, and the Nucleus Threat Rating (NTR) to enrich every CVE, automate threat-informed action, and focus remediation on exposures that truly matter. 

MOBILIZATION  

Remediate at Scale 

Nucleus automates task assignments and ownership, streamlining the remediation process across teams and ensuring accountability. By establishing a common risk language across the organization, Nucleus enables consistent communication and alignment on remediation priorities. 

Key Exposure Management Capabilities 

Gain visibility and automate risk-based workflows to scale and expand your Threat Exposure Management program. 

Centralize Your Program in One Hub 

Unify visibility and manage your exposures across every attack surface in one platform. 

Prioritize Risk with Business Context 

Consolidate asset and broad metadata to effectively prioritize, group, and automate with business context. 

Unify and Customize Risk Scoring 

Standardize risk prioritization with unified risk scores that are customized to your business needs. 

Bring in Pen-Testing and Validation Results 

Incorporate the results of penetration tests, audits, and other exposure validation sources into your prioritization framework. 

Integrate Threat Intelligence 

Enrich your vulnerabilities and exposures with real-world data from premium and open sources threat and exploit intelligence feeds. 

Automate Ownership Assignment 

Map owners and teams in your organization’s hierarchy to your asset inventory using dynamic automations.
